charged_covariance.K_basic_specialization: zero only when the receiver is declared K-basic
charged_covariance.origin_covariance: psi and tau must co-shift by s
charged_covariance.primitive_orientation: psi'=eta psi+s, Q'=eta Q, tau'=eta tau+s with eta=+/-1 gives O'_A(tau')=eta O_A(tau); A'=eta A makes the scalar event invariant

claim_boundary: Certifies an exact finite-resolution approximate-identity theorem for the conditional charged-time event-map chain contract, including BV descent, charged covariance, support inheritance, distributional convergence, profile error/composition bounds and conditional frequency-ratio error control. It does not certify a nonzero counterflow receiver, detector, redshift, global monotone compact clock, nonlinear dynamics, phenomenology or quantum observable.

clock_topology_and_reduction.compact_phase: use the periodicized profile sum_n kappa_epsilon(theta+2*pi*n), or one chart with epsilon r_kappa below the cut distance; this is sampling on S1, not a globally monotone real clock
clock_topology_and_reduction.fixed_charge: the parent rank criterion still removes the one-clock D class when fixed-Q reduction makes D null
clock_topology_and_reduction.lifted_line: monotonicity requires H'(Q) fixed nonzero sign; the lifted clock is unbounded

conditional_counterflow.reason: NO_CERTIFIED_MAP: same-background Berger harmonic inclusions, projections, physical quotient bases and descended pairings are not exported
conditional_counterflow.sampling_theorem_applicable_when: a nonradical same-background receiver carrier and period land

distributional_limit.statement: O_A^epsilon -> O_A in D'(R_tau) as epsilon->0+
distributional_limit.test_class: C_c^infinity(R_tau) tensored with compactly supported receiver-current tests on M

finite_resolution_bounds.two_phase_map_composition: ||Phi_2^epsilon o Phi_1^epsilon-Phi_2 o Phi_1|| <= E_2+L_2 E_1
